Gros-Caillou (7e arr.) — Paris, France

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

This quartier contains the Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars, and is the one part of the 7th arrondissement with well-documented, recurring problems. By day, French press and police have repeatedly covered organised illegal souvenir vendors clashing with police and targeting/pickpocketing tourists around the tower, prompting a major municipal police operation with over 100 officers in August 2025 and prior crackdown efforts ahead of the 2024 Olympics. More seriously, French outlets reported sexual assaults on tourists at the Champ de Mars at night, serious enough that right-wing city councillors publicly called for the park to be closed after dark and security around the monument was questioned ahead of the Olympics. Extra caution after dark in this specific park area is warranted; the tower itself and surrounding streets by day are heavily patrolled. Sources checked: franceinfo, 2023 (report ahead of Paris 2024 on street vendors); policeetrealites.com, August 2025 (police operation vs. illegal vendors); ici/France Bleu, 2023 ("soupçons de viol sur le Champ-de-Mars", calls to close the park at night); Fox News, 2023 ("Eiffel Tower crime wave").
